name: esp32_devkit
title: ESP32 DevKit, 4 MB
description: A standard ESP32 dev board with a CP210x USB bridge, a power LED, a second LED and a BOOT button
notes: A board sold by many makers, so no maker is written and no schematic was read.
The LED follows GPIO 2. With an internal pull-up that pin reads about 0 V, lower than an LED to ground gives, so something else is on the line too; what it is is not known.

pins.source: Anton: a standard dev board with two LEDs; the pin is the usual one of this board

led.notes: On the board of the local terminal the LED blinks while terminal_test toggles GPIO 2. A blink does not show which level lights it.

chip.source: esptool on the board of the local terminal: ESP32-D0WD-V3 rev 3.0, 4 MB, CP210x port
